study.question: Under the identical causal 128-event input boundary, how much of the explicit-count gain comes from target matches rather than visible activity, and does the learned history summary add predictive value conditional on those counts?
study.hypothesis: A deterministic target-conditioned multiset count representation can retain much of the useful history information at lower arithmetic cost than learned event attention. Target-match counts C,B,J should add value beyond visible length N. This is a prospective local compression hypothesis, not established sufficiency: normalized attention can still retain type, age, nonmatching fields and distributed similarity that four counts discard.

nearest_work.source_ref: paper:din; arxiv:1706.06978v4; content-sha256:5fee25f33f375e51b3ee9417d376ff9dbe2ea3628c932a7679ddfeb0feaaade2; primary text lines 235-277, especially 266-277; text sha256 83fb9eeca31e2fa3c557b6f08b893ad0018cefb33da6e00952136b9ce17e607e
nearest_work.difference: DIN uses a learned target-conditional weighted sum and explicitly relaxes normalization to preserve interest intensity. The local reference instead uses normalized softmax and category/brand/action/age sums. We replace that local learned summary with four deterministic bounded log counts; no claim of inventing intensity preservation, exact DIN reproduction or global priority.

nearest_work.difference: Its explicit per-layer learned dot-product readout motivates examining direct relevance, and its tiny-mode sequence-attention ablation raises a redundancy question. Four equality counts with optional removal of event embeddings implement neither the FM Highway nor dual buses, fusion, pretraining, auxiliary supervision or optimizer recipe. Source ablations do not establish local effects.

nearest_work.difference: Only author README is available here, warning that behavior has category, brand and type rather than item identity. Counts compare supplied bucket IDs and never assume historical item IDs. Full DMR mechanism remains unverified.

The parent already concatenates N,C,B,J counts with learned attention. The new candidate removes the learned summary computationally while retaining the exact four count transforms, output input width, parameter allocation and initialization order. This is a follow-up replacement, not new invention of counts.

inherited_components: Frozen first-six-day training, natural prevalence, three epochs, batch size 4096, same supplied causal prefix capped at 128 events, validation identities/scorer and train seed 42. No data, label, history coverage, sampling, loss, optimizer or learning-rate changes.
Parent static embedding tables, action and recency embeddings, target query, normalized attention scorer, MLP [128,64], embedding_dim 16, lr 0.001, module allocation order and all parameter shapes.
Parent observed same-event N,C,B,J statistics, zero/missing exclusions, log1p divided by log(129), and empty-history zero summary. Equality is over possibly colliding supplied bucket IDs.

Joint channel retained to avoid a second change relative to the parent; g1-r0002-independent_count and g1-r0002-independent_rate supply negative single-seed evidence for a uniquely useful conjunction signal.
study.proposed_difference: Three new standalone variants complete a 2x2 replacement design with existing g1-r0002-joint_count as the attention+match cell: count_summary (zero learned summary, full N,C,B,J), activity_summary (zero learned summary, N with three zero slots), attention_activity (unchanged learned summary, N with three zero slots). Zero-summary variants do not execute age embeddings, action embeddings, historical category/brand embedding lookups or attention. All modules remain allocated and optimizer defaults stay inherited, so registered parameter count and random initialization are matched; effective feature rank, gradient paths and runtime differ intentionally. Prospective plan recorded before implementation; only syntax/source checks are authorized locally.
predictions: Primary activity-controlled relevance contrasts: AUC(count_summary)-AUC(activity_summary)>0 and AUC(g1-r0002-joint_count)-AUC(attention_activity)>0; report both with unweighted Logloss and the interaction, without treating a one-seed gap as significance.

Compression prediction: count_summary loses at most 0.0005 validation AUC against g1-r0002-joint_count and does not worsen Logloss by more than 0.0002. These are predeclared practical screening tolerances, not statistical equivalence bounds. A larger loss indicates incremental information in the learned history branch.

The skipped branch should reduce training and inference computation, but host gathering and large static embeddings may dominate. Require measured host cost; an efficiency claim requires at least 10 percent lower allocated GPU or train seconds and no slower end-to-end inference p50/p95 beyond 5 percent, with repeats before a firm frontier claim.

Explore frozen host slices, especially empty/short histories, category-match present/absent and training frequency, always retaining counts of examples and both labels. Candidate diagnostics describe only the first 512 validation impressions and cannot establish population prevalence.
falsifiers: If target-match slots do not improve either activity-controlled contrast, target relevance is not supported as the driver of the parent gain; visible length, changed output width or optimization remain explanations.

If removing learned attention exceeds the practical loss tolerances, four-count compression is inadequate under this recipe. This does not refute direct count utility or all deterministic history representations.

If learned attention remains useful only with activity, a negative interaction supports partial redundancy rather than universal sufficiency. If attention helps equally with full counts, redundancy is unsupported.
No measured cost saving means the proposed arithmetic reduction is not an established efficiency improvement. Same allocated parameter count cannot support parameter compression.
A favorable single seed or exploratory slice is preliminary. Seed reversals or cluster uncertainty crossing the practical tolerance prevent a robust equivalence or mechanism claim.
alternative_explanations: Prior trajectories: g1-r0000-behavior_within 0.6119128872 vs interleaved_within 0.6130423104, and behavior_global 0.6130418222 vs interleaved_global 0.6131550076, do not support action-specific slots. g1-r0001-field_values 0.6131854897 is below collapsed_values 0.6133112730 and baseline-din 0.6133619861; collapsed_rms falls to 0.6125376996. These are completed negative implementations, not runtime failures or refutations of every group mechanism.

g1-r0002-joint_count AUC 0.6171272214 exceeds baseline-din by 0.0037652352, but independent_count is 0.6171229817 (difference 0.0000042397). Count versus rate gaps are about 0.00237 in both joint modes. The count/rate experiment changes activity and target representation together and does not identify which count matters.

The parent improves even on empty histories (8272 impressions, 310 positives, 7962 negatives; AUC 0.5886744 vs baseline 0.5789482), where all new counts equal zero. Shared training, initial output shape, calibration and seed effects can improve slices without a slice-specific count signal. Long-history slices contain 3026583 impressions, so aggregate gains need not transfer to rare histories.

First-512 parent diagnostics report 85.15625 percent at the history cap and target brand missing on 9.9609375 percent. Truncation can make N a censoring indicator and equality counts miss raw identities; these small-sample diagnostics are not population estimates.

Zeroing inputs matches nominal tensors but lowers effective rank and removes gradient paths. Adam state allocation and overfitting change with branch removal. Cost is deliberately unmatched in the removal contrast; no equal-compute superiority claim follows from matched epochs alone.

Static snapshot as-of dates are undocumented. This is a frozen benchmark with causal behavior prefixes, not verified production point-in-time evaluation. There are no independent repeated seeds or authorized test results in the supplied record.

contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: Treat the target-relevance account as unsupported; investigate activity and output-capacity explanations before adding richer count features.

contrasts.intervention: Factorial interaction: [AUC(parent)-AUC(count_summary)] - [AUC(attention_activity)-AUC(activity_summary)], and the analogous Logloss contrast.
contrasts.control: All four cells, with existing parent supplying attention+matches.
held_fixed: all nominal tensor capacity and registered training conditions
remaining_confounds: AUC is nonlinear and repeated exposures share users
Zero slots change effective functional capacity
contrasts.decision_if_supported: A smaller attention gain with full counts supports local partial redundancy if repeated; preserve both individual attention effects in reporting.
contrasts.decision_if_not_supported: If attention is similarly useful in both cells, retain it; if interaction changes sign or is small, report null/uncertain interaction and avoid redundancy claims.

knowledge_assessments.rationale: Reviewed latest declared use alongside all four count/rate outcomes. Direct counts help the local normalized reference, but observed conjunction has virtually no increment over independence; declared source use is provenance, not proof of source value. Primary section 5.3 reports limited sequence-attention benefit in its tiny mode, motivating a local removal test.
knowledge_assessments.transformed_mechanism: Retain the parent deterministic direct relevance readout and prospectively remove its learned event-summary path; factorial N-only controls separate direct matches from activity.
knowledge_assessments.nearest_work_difference: Four bucket-equality statistics and optional history removal; no FM Highway, buses, per-layer dots, shared multiquery pipeline, auxiliary delay head or optimizer change. Does not reproduce UniDot and does not establish global novelty.
knowledge_assessments.falsifier: If attention removal loses quality beyond the frozen tolerances or match slots do not beat N-only controls, the corresponding local redundancy/relevance explanation fails.
